'''Asteroid Mining Units''' were mining utility stations built by [[Byblos Drive Yards/Legends|Byblos Drive Yards]].

==Description==
An Asteroid Mining Unit was a stationary utility station used to extract minerals from [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], then eject the extracted material out of the interior of an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]]. Slightly smaller than a [[Strike-class medium cruiser|Strike Cruiser]], they were unarmed, but were equipped with [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]]. These stations were unmanned, and had no internal [[Hangar/Legends|docking facilities]].<ref name="XWA" />

==History==
The Asteroid Mining Unit was built by [[Byblos Drive Yards/Legends|Byblos Drive Yards]], one of many products they produced to aid in [[Mining/Legends|mining]] activities. They were used by a variety of organizations.<ref name="XWA" /> At least one Asteroid Mining Unit was used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] to supply the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], [[XP-MU 3376]] in the asteroid field of the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]].<ref name="xwab6m7">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' Battle 6, Mission 7: "Family Reunion"</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Though the station's description in ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'' lists them as being in use by "various,"<ref name="XWA" /> only one Asteroid Mining Unit is ever seen, in the [[Mission to Kessel Station|"Family Reunion" mission]].<ref name="xwab6m7" />
